summaries.python-aws: Python + AWS Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in Python backend development, AWS cloud-native architecture (Lambda, EC2, S3), RESTful API design, and distributed systems. Led an AWS SDK migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services at Turbot HQ, keeping production systems supported past AWS SDK v2 end-of-life while cutting policy-code duplication ~60%.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, giving LLM agents standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data for retrieval and analysis.

Built a RAG-based internal Pydantic AI agent in Python to resolve cross-team queries, ingesting internal documentation into S3 vector storage; deployed it as a serverless AWS Lambda function and integrated it with the Slack Bot API for instant developer access.

Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework to power the backend of Turbot Guardrails, a cloud-native SaaS platform; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Built a Kafka-based, event-driven distributed pipeline where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was successfully enforced; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture recurring failures for debugging.

Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services (SecurityHub, CloudWatch, ControlTower, Shield, Comprehend, Pinpoint, RAM, X-Ray, EC2, EFS) in production Lambdas; reduced policy-code duplication ~60% via templating, keeping the platform supported past AWS SDK v2 EOL.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements and multi-stage CTEs — improving query performance 40% and eliminating a class of false-positive findings.
